sentences.text: This criminal petition is filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C. seeking to quash the proceedings against the petitioners/Accused-1 to 7, 16 & 18 to 22 in CC.No.64 of 2019 on the file of the Junior Civil Judge, Piduguralla.
The offences alleged are under Sections 420, 273, 188 and 120(B) r/w 34 IPC and Sections 58, 59 and 63 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
This Court has heard Sri Raja Reddy Koneti, learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor for respondent-State.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that in a similar case, this Court, by virtue of common order in Criminal Petition Nos.3731 of 2018 and batch, quashed the proceedings against the petitioners therein by considering that transportation of Gutka is not attracted by the offences alleged under Sections 188, 270 and 273 of IPC and Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
A perusal of the order shows that this Court, by considering that transportation of Gutka does not attract the offences alleged, quashed the proceedings.

Hence, following the said order and in terms thereof, the criminal petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioners-Accused-1 to 7, 16 & 18 to 22 in CC.No.64 of 2019 on the file of the Junior Civil Judge, Piduguralla, are hereby quashed.
As a sequel, the miscellaneous applications, if any pending, shall stand closed.

D.V.S.S.SOMAYAJULU, J Date: 24.07.2019 KLP K Narasimha Rao vs The State Of Ap on 24 July, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/162672591/
